cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. First you cancel lunch, then stop calling, then ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch. I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. That's what he said before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then? I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too. Public enough that I couldn't beg. Book the corner, please.
